notes.title: Civil War: 1862 v4.1.1 Update
notes.content:

[*] Change: A reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Updated the play balance in the 'Shiloh Church scenario'.
[*] Fix: A critical issue displaying the loss meters after the previous graphics update.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: An error preventing the 'Game Updates' text from appearing.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[/list]

notes.title: Second patch released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've just released the second patch for 1862.  This minor update fixes a problem on Windows machines with sound effects not playing.

Hope all are enjoying the battlefields of 1862.  If anyone has any suggestions for any new features or any other ideas related to Civil War: 1862, we'd really appreciate it.  Thanks for supporting our games!

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: First Patch Released!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We've just released the first patch for 'Civil War: 1862'!  This update addresses a number of minor issues that should give a much improved gameplay experience.
[list]
[*] Fix an issue with side selection not working in "Fresh Troops" campaign.
[*] Significantly improve UI menus and alignments.
[*] Fixed campaign victory windows not displaying some elements.
[/list]

We hope this will make the game experience a lot more enjoyable.

Any feedback please let us know on the forum or by emailing support@hexwar.com

~The HexWar Team

tags.bug: [*] Fix an issue with side selection not working in "Fresh Troops" campaign.
[*] Fixed campaign victory windows not displaying some elements.

notes.title: New Campaign Available!
notes.content:
Changes in this version include:

[list]
[*] New 8 scenario "Broken Line" campaign available. Play as either the Union or the Confederates! 
[*] Savage’s station mission could sometimes end on turn 16 rather than as intended on turn 18.
[/list]

Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming! 

~ The HexWar Games Team
